meta.name: deck-ljg-present
meta.description: 把 outline 1:1 铸成色块大字宣言 deck, 原文不动只做美化。三档主题 black / red / yellow

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大纲一键转成大字宣言风格幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速把文字大纲变成视觉冲击力强的演示文稿。
copy.tagline_en: Turn outlines into bold statement decks with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text outlines into visually impactful presentations.

howto.what: 把你给的 outline 或 markdown 原文一字不改地排成单文件 HTML 演示 deck：色块大字、每页一屏，只做物理分页不做改写，主题色在 black / red / yellow 中三选一。
howto.when: 当你有一份 outline 或 markdown 稿子，想做成宣言式大字演讲幻灯片时接管；提到「宣言」「演讲」等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 把这份 outline 做成 red 主题的宣言 deck
say.note: 输出单文件 HTML，原文不改字

say.text: 用 yellow 主题把这篇文章排成大字幻灯片
这段 markdown 不要改写，只做分页排成 deck

howto.what_en: Turns your outline or markdown into a self-contained HTML deck: one big color-block page per screen. Text stays word-for-word, only pagination is applied, and you pick one theme: black, red, or yellow.
howto.when_en: Use it when you have an outline or markdown draft to turn into a manifesto-style big-type deck. Words like “manifesto” or “keynote” also trigger it.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a red-theme manifesto deck
say_en.note: Outputs one self-contained HTML file, text unchanged

say_en.text: Lay this article out as big-type slides in the yellow theme
Don't rewrite this markdown, just paginate it into a deck
say_en.note: Splits pages only, no extraction or reordering
